takeaways: Manual note-taking after each job costs technicians time and degrades data accuracy, which ripples into scheduling, billing, inventory and warranty claims.
Copilot in Dynamics 365 turns a short voice update into structured work order fields and a readable service history, using job, asset and parts context from the CRM.
Connected, real-time capture lets Copilot surface past fixes, stage parts mid-job and feed billing, scheduling and Power BI dashboards from a single source of truth.
hook: Field technicians often spend twenty minutes per job typing notes, and the resulting data is late and error-prone. This episode is for Dynamics 365 Field Service leaders and service managers, showing how Copilot turns spoken updates into accurate work orders, in-the-moment troubleshooting and proactive parts planning.
